content.comment_body: Is it possible to use an input as a switch to start (run mode) and stop my program?
No, that's not possible. You can only use an input to control whether program processing is enabled or blocked. However, the [product_name] device itself cannot be started or stopped using an input.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked if an input could be used to fully start or stop the entire program operation on the hardware, but was informed this is not possible. Inputs can only govern the execution of parts of the program logic, not the main operating state of the device. This demonstrates a device limitation that could impact how users expect to control its operation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to use a single input as a Run/Stop switch to start or stop the whole program.
pain_keywords: cannot fully control run/stop from input
